reactors.title: T-junction, narrow tubes (SS316)
reactors.description: Two opposed 2 mm inlets meeting one outlet, 219,530 cells. The production geometry: the finest mesh here, and the slowest to solve.

reactors.title: T-junction
reactors.description: Two opposed inlets meeting one outlet, 170,385 cells. Same topology as the SS316 reactor on a coarser mesh, so it answers the same questions sooner.

reactors.title: Multi-port manifold
reactors.description: Three inlets and two outlets. Coarse: a topology probe rather than a quantitative reactor.

reactors.title: Splitter
reactors.description: One inlet, two outlets. A single inlet cannot dose two reactants separately, so this geometry suits flow studies rather than reactions.

reactors.title: Vertical pipe
reactors.description: One inlet, one outlet, 632 cells. Small enough to run the whole chain in about a minute, which makes it the smoke test.

structuredContent.default_note: An A + B reaction needs a reactor with two or more inlets (supports_two_reactant_feed). 'available: false' means this deployment does not carry that mesh file.
